anomalies.description: A white truck entering from the left collides with a beige sedan crossing the intersection from right to left; the sedan is struck on its left side and spins violently, kicking up dust and debris.
A light-colored sedan collides with a white truck at an intersection, causing the sedan to rotate sharply and kick up dust; the impact is visible in the initial frames.
A silver sedan loses control, veers sharply right, and flips onto its roof in a violent crash, ejecting debris and generating smoke/dust.

A silver sedan on the right side of the road suddenly veers left, collides with the road surface or an unseen obstacle, and rolls over multiple times across the lane, coming to rest upside down near the camera vehicle. Debris and dust are ejected during the rollover.
A vehicle is seen rolling over and coming to rest on its side/roof after a crash, with smoke/dust and debris visible throughout the sequence.
A dark SUV is stopped at an angle on the right shoulder, partially in the snowbank, with visible damage to its front end and debris scattered on the road—indicating a recent collision.

A person exits a vehicle on the left side of the road (around f6), walks toward another vehicle, and appears to engage in a physical confrontation with someone near that vehicle between f7 and f11; movements suggest mutual grappling or striking.
